component-o.description-s: Low-loss PowerPath ideal-diode controller, drives external P-channel MOSFET

cfgpins-ao.3c: tie to gnd for automatic primary/auxiliary switchover

cfgpins-ao.4c: open-drain status output; may float unconnected

supplies-ao.ripple_not_stated-s: not stated: LTC4412 Rev. C gives no input ripple limit; p3 forward regulation VIN - VSENSE 10 / 20 / 32 mV min / typ / max (2.5 V <= VIN <= 28 V) is the only regulation figure

carried_source-o.table-s: Electrical Characteristics: VIN, VSENSE Operating Supply Range, VIN and/or VSENSE Must Be in This Range for Proper Operation, 2.5 V min, 28 V max (full Tj range); Absolute Maximum Ratings p2: Supply Voltage (VIN) -14 V to 36V; pin configuration p2: VIN 1, SENSE 6. The controller passes the load current through an external P-channel MOSFET (GATE pin 5), so it has no load step of its own

provenance-o.basis-s: procurement public-check: every document in the record folder has a public http(s) source; nothing confidential, no correspondence or quote data, no person named outside non-technical-o, not an NDA part; footprint and 3D model of recorded public origin
